contracts.mode: collaborationMode/list native masks; start options.collaborationMode with explicit/resolved model, reasoning_effort and builtin developer_instructions:null. Steer/queue do not silently apply composer mode/model overrides.
contracts.continuation: Automatic hydration calls only thread/session. requiresResume:true exposes an explicit durable thread/resume action, gated on complete history. Settings/closed/notLoaded notifications and accepted continuation receipts refresh pure session state.
contracts.input: turn/steer carries expectedTurnId and stable clientUserMessageId; thread/queue/add carries stable clientUserMessageId. Accepted proof clears only matching draft revision; unresolved input blocks another send/steer/queue operation in that scope.
contracts.queue: Native list/add/update/delete/reorder/start. Edits omit attachmentIds to preserve runtime retained inputs. Reorder requires complete list and <=100 IDs. Active turns cannot queue/start. Idle queue additions may immediately execute; UI describes native scheduling, not a manual-only queue.
contracts.goal: get/set/clear with explicit origin:user. Optional positive token budget; null explicitly removes existing budget. Pause/clear do not stop active turns. Continue and new-goal labels disclose possible task activation.
contracts.branch: thread/fork beforeTurnId or lastTurnId, native deferGoalContinuation enforced by runtime. Edit workflow saves a source-scoped branch draft, creates a child, saves its draft and opens it; sending is a separate explicit action after full hydration. Unknown/accepted receipt identity permits opening the original child without duplicate fork. thread/revert is visibly history-only and triggers a complete reread.
contracts.review: review/start inline or explicit review/startNew with uncommittedChanges/baseBranch/commit/custom target. Native accepted result is not presented as completed review. Creation identity remains in recovery.
contracts.agents: thread/agents/list native parent IDs form an indented bounded tree; direct controls require canAcceptDirectInput:true. Child browsing never silently grants direct-input capability.
contracts.search: thread/search is project scoped by backend; empty filtered pages retain load-more. Current-thread searchOccurrences locates existing turn/item anchors or reads a separate history/window partial view; partial windows never replace full history readiness.
contracts.export: thread/export json/markdown is an independent bounded complete-history operation. Safe filename/MIME/content validation; failures never fall back to exporting the currently rendered partial window.
